venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH (Sun 7/12)** — MOD & Chef: KK / MD / Kev. Net $1,167 vs $1,500 target (78%). 44 guests, $26.51 check avg. Comps $37.20 (3.2%). A chill Sunday — quiet across the area per industry friends. Saw friends from upstairs and down the hall plus a couple of returning regulars. Kitchen smooth ($93 food). Maintenance: chiller. 86: Tanqueray and Lalo (both in Tuesday). Favorite moment: a mom and daughter celebrating the daughter's 22nd birthday, dressed up for a night on the town. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR (Sun 7/12)** — AM MOD Maggie H, PM MOD Carey. Net $9,506.31 vs $10,441 target (91%). 157 guests (Tock), $60.55 check avg. Comps $304.60 (3.20%). Food $2,051.40; no events. AM/Cafe $1,048.57, D&C PM $8,457.74, Garden/6A $2,447.43. Very sleepy evening across all departments — a nice reprieve after a busy weekend. Great guest engagement; Garden stayed steady all night. Kitchen slow but good vibes. Favorite moment: even though slow, the team took time to engage with guests and each other — real bonding that doesn't happen when everyone's at full steam. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 7/12 (MOD: Thomas; Chef: Alejandro).** Net sales $3,587 vs a $4,590 target (−22%); 93 covers at a $39 check average; comps $122.16. Splits: food $476, beverage $3,111; no events. Median weather for the month. A nice first push (1k+ from the 6pm tables) that fizzled into a steady drip of friends reminiscing and late-week date couples wanting space to unwind — lots of one-and-dones, no covers past 11:15 though several late arrivals stuck around to last call. 4 fours, 5 solos, zero large parties. Top sellers: Fries and the Burner Phone Daiquiri (tie). Door: lovely cooler summer weather, small line at open with nearly everyone wanting the bar (many tourists with the books); ~2/3 full by 7:30 then slow the rest of the night. Welcomed investor Bruce Wanner with family, regular Fitore with a friend, Zack (Tock/Resy), and Joshua (MASA). Two no-shows charged (Sofia Weissman 3 at 8:15, Andrew Ni 2 at 9:30). 1 tulip broken.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA (Sun 7/12)** — MOD & Chef: Joe / Oscar / Saleh. Net $4,614 vs $5,165 target (89%). 104 guests, $88.75 check avg. Comps $66 (Alfredo, Dinora + Martin, birthday, DNL). Food $1,140; standing room $0. A well-paced Sunday — quiet first couple hours gave time for cleaning and prep for the week. Familiar faces plus first-timers who nerded out with Mitchell over Armagnac. Room filled around 8:30pm and stayed relatively full with a smooth last call. Steady kitchen night. Favorite moment: seeing familiar faces at the bar. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC (Sun 7/12)** — MOD: Josh. Net $2,417.41 vs $1,944 target (124%). 55 guests, $43.17 GCA. Comps $24 (0.9%). Food $239.80; Garden closed. Slow but steady night, mostly two-top reservations with a handful of walk-ins. Service ran smooth; team built strong guest connections and pulled out a few DC Compendiums in conversation, which guests loved. Kitchen snacks only. Finished the week above goal. Favorite moment: Ian describing the drink menu for guests. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG (Sun 7/12)** — AM MOD Sam, PM MOD Braden. Net $6,112 vs $7,000 target (87%). Guests 168 (84 AM / 84 PM). Comps $359. Food $1,881. Muni Bar AM $1,072, PM $6,098; Sun Club $257; Hot Eye $1,598. Back to slow-season business — one of the slower Sundays in a while, waiting for a late-afternoon pop that never came. Evening bar nearly full once around 7pm; some later 5- and 6-tops boosted sales. Sun Club super slow with a storm at closing. Hot Eye opened early for a Bastille Day French-community turnout (30 became 60), then lulls broken by a bar crawl and small industry crowd. Maintenance: Hot Eye low-boy freezer not holding temp. Favorite moment: Brigid's last day before her European adventure. Entered by Alexis.
